title: Inside the Piano Action  (钢琴机械内部)

segments.t: 在九号房间，格雷厄姆跪在工具箱旁，小心翼翼地拆下立式钢琴的前面板，而伊夫林小姐和迦勒则注视着那排毛毡击弦机弦槌。先听整场戏。
I have fixed boilers, locks, and clocks, ma'am, but never a piano.
A piano is just honest wood, wool felt, and steel wire, Graham.
Press the key to the left first so we see how a healthy hammer moves.
Watch C rise smoothly and strike the three strings, clean and bright.
Now press the silent key right next to it.
Look: the key goes down, but the little wooden hammer leans sideways!
Shine the lamp closer. The tiny brass hinge pin slipped half out of the wood!
Wait... nothing is cracked! The damp air thirty years ago only loosened the felt bushing!
Can you seat a tiny pin that small without splitting the beechwood, Graham?
Give me quiet light, thin tweezers, and dry glue tomorrow morning.
Once that hammer stands straight, Evelyn can tune the whole middle octave?
Do you have a tuning key in the chest, Graham? Look in the bottom drawer!
现在让我们一步步回顾每段对话。
I have fixed boilers, locks, and clocks, ma'am, but never a piano.
“我修过锅炉、锁和钟表，夫人，但从没修过钢琴。”为了总结职业生涯中积累的经验，这里使用了现在完成时
I have fixed
伴随着尊称ma'am，即madam的缩写。
A piano is just honest wood, wool felt, and steel wire, Graham.
“钢琴不过是优质木材、羊毛毡和钢丝而已，格雷厄姆。”两种传统材料结合在
wool felt,
其中felt是覆盖在弦槌上以缓冲敲击的压制布料。
Press the key to the left first so we see how a healthy hammer moves.
“先按左边的琴键，让我们看看完好的弦槌是怎么移动的。”敲击琴弦的包毡部件与木匠的锤子同名：
a healthy hammer
很自然地用healthy来形容运转良好的机械部件。
Watch C rise smoothly and strike the three strings, clean and bright.
“看C音琴键如何平稳升起，敲击那三根琴弦，声音清脆明亮。”在watch等感官动词之后，描述完整动作的动词不带to：
Watch C rise smoothly and strike
其中C在英美音名中代表do音。
Now press the silent key right next to it.
“现在按下紧挨着的那颗无声琴键。”为了指出紧邻旁边的东西，用right来加强next to：
right next to it.
从C音转到中央D音。
Look: the key goes down, but the little wooden hammer leans sideways!
“看：琴键按下了，但小木槌却倒向了一边！”当某物倾斜或侧向弯曲而不是直线上升时，就会出现这个词组
leans sideways!
其中后缀-ways表示方向。
Shine the lamp closer. The tiny brass hinge pin slipped half out of the wood!
“把灯拿近点。铰链上微小的黄铜销钉从木头里退出来一半了！”为了将手电筒或灯的光束指向某处，shine作为及物动词用于
Shine the lamp closer.
而hinge pin指的是旋转的小圆柱轴。
Wait... nothing is cracked! The damp air thirty years ago only loosened the felt bushing!
“等等……没有任何东西开裂！只是三十年前潮湿的空气让毛毡轴衬松动了！”由形容词loose（松的）加后缀-en衍生出动词
loosened
而bushing是轴在其中旋转的内衬。
Can you seat a tiny pin that small without splitting the beechwood, Graham?
“格雷厄姆，你能把这么微小的销钉安好而不让榉木开裂吗？”在机械和木工中，动词seat意思是使部件就位或嵌入其槽中：
seat a tiny pin
不让the beechwood，即榉木开裂。
Give me quiet light, thin tweezers, and dry glue tomorrow morning.
“明早给我一盏稳定的灯、一把细镊子和干胶水。”就像scissors（剪刀）或glasses（眼镜）一样，由两个对称臂组成的工具用复数：
thin tweezers,
是夹取毫米级零件必不可少的。
Once that hammer stands straight, Evelyn can tune the whole middle octave?
“一旦那个弦槌变直，伊夫林就能给整个中央八度调音了吗？”除了作为名词表示旋律外，tune还可作为动词用于调整琴弦的张力在
tune the whole middle octave?
将准确的音准恢复到中音区。
Do you have a tuning key in the chest, Graham? Look in the bottom drawer!
“格雷厄姆，你箱子里有调音扳手吗？看看最下面的抽屉！”用来转动钢琴弦轴的L形扳手被称为
a tuning key
放在这里的the bottom drawer，即最下面的抽屉。让我们再听一遍完整的对话。
I have fixed boilers, locks, and clocks, ma'am, but never a piano.
A piano is just honest wood, wool felt, and steel wire, Graham.
Press the key to the left first so we see how a healthy hammer moves.
Watch C rise smoothly and strike the three strings, clean and bright.
Now press the silent key right next to it.
Look: the key goes down, but the little wooden hammer leans sideways!
Shine the lamp closer. The tiny brass hinge pin slipped half out of the wood!
Wait... nothing is cracked! The damp air thirty years ago only loosened the felt bushing!
Can you seat a tiny pin that small without splitting the beechwood, Graham?
Give me quiet light, thin tweezers, and dry glue tomorrow morning.
Once that hammer stands straight, Evelyn can tune the whole middle octave?
Do you have a tuning key in the chest, Graham? Look in the bottom drawer!
没有一块木头开裂：只有一个微小的黄铜销钉在等待格雷厄姆稳健的手法。让我们立刻看看阳光是如何回到画廊窗户上的。
Take care!
